'''Chapter 989''' is titled "I Can't Imagine Losing".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[["Gang" Bege's Oh My Family]] Vol. 33: "Like, I have proof!!"

[[Pound]] provides proof for his claims by showing a picture of [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] kicking him out, with baby [[Charlotte Chiffon|Chiffon]] and [[Charlotte Lola|Lola]] in the background.

==Short Summary==
While [[Shinobu]] and [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] are scared by [[Yamato]] claiming to be [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] and run off, [[Franky]] fires a Radical Beam to save [[Usopp]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] from one of the [[Jaki|Numbers]]. Before [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] could attack Franky, [[Jinbe]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] intervene and force her off the [[Onigashima#Live Floor|Live Floor]]. Meanwhile [[Queen]] prevents [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] from going after Kaidou. Once Franky forms [[Battle Frankies/General Franky|General Franky]] and [[Sanji]] recovers from his battle with [[King]], all of the Straw Hats assemble on the Live Floor.

==Long Summary==
As a distressed [[Napoleon]] calls out to the fallen [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], [[Nami]] thanks [[Franky]] for saving her and [[Jinbe]] asks [[Nico Robin|Robin]] to help him out. With Big Mom out of the way, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] resumes heading to the dome roof, and upon seeing [[Shinobu]] and [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] running away from [[Yamato]], Luffy assures them that Yamato is an ally. However, the duo are aghast when Yamato claims to be [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]], causing Shinobu to throw a smoke bomb to escape. Big Mom quickly gets up, and the Beasts Pirates start running away with the fear that she will soon rampage; [[Hyougoro]] and [[Yatappe]] then decide to leave the low-level pirate hordes and go after the Tobiroppo, if only to slow them down. Big Mom recognizes [[Brook]], and Franky introduces himself to her. Nami tells Franky to retreat, as Big Mom is an [[Four Emperors|Emperor of the Sea]], but Franky scoffs at that as they are the crew of the future Pirate King.

Franky prepares to fire a '''Radical Beam''' at Big Mom, but is then distracted by three [[Numbers]] rampaging behind him.  Big Mom is excited to see the Numbers, which she reveals to be failed [[Gigantification|recreations]] of the Ancient Giants from [[Punk Hazard]]. Franky notices that the central Number, [[Jaki]], is holding the [[Brachio Tank V]] in his hand, and promptly fires the '''Radical Beam''' in Jaki's face, sending him flying back and forcing him to let go of the tank. With Franky's back now turned on her, Big Mom attempts to strike him with Napoleon. However, Jinbe proceeds to jump up and grab her outstretched arm, pulling it behind her to flip her over. Big Mom is sent tumbling onto two rows of [[Hana Hana no Mi|arms]] generated from the floor by Robin, and Robin sends her spinning all the way over the ledge to a lower level. Their attack's success makes Jinbe and Robin happy, though Jinbe knows it has only made Big Mom angrier.

Franky contacts Usopp and Chopper inside the Brachio Tank, and Chopper pulls Usopp out of his scared stupor as the duo excitedly find out that it is time to dock. Meanwhile, Luffy has made it up to the Performance Stage where [[Queen]] is and prepares to pull himself up to the dome roof. Right then, Zoro appears next to Queen onstage, and when Luffy tells him he is going to fight [[Kaidou]], Zoro grabs his feet to accompany him up. However, Queen quickly transforms into his [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Brachiosaurus|brachiosaurus form]] and grabs Luffy and Zoro in midair with his mouth. [[King]] and several winged [[SMILE]] users then appear in the air above Queen, cutting off any chance of Luffy and Zoro making it to the roof. Queen spits out the two pirates down to the ground far below. On the ground, Usopp and Chopper are ejected from the Brachio Tank in order for it to dock with [[General Franky]], while [[Sanji]] emerges from the wreckage of King's attack with his [[Raid Suit]] having held up. As the Straw Hats gather all together, Hyougoro states that although the alliance is surrounded by enemies on all sides, he cannot imagine losing. Luffy tells his crew to back him up as he makes another attempt to get up to the dome roof.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Yamato]] meets [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Shinobu]].
**Due to Yamato's claim of being [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]], it ends up scaring both of them into running away.
*[[Hyougoro]] and his group decide to go after and fight the [[Beasts Pirates#Tobiroppo|Tobiroppo]].
*More of the [[Numbers]] are shown.
**[[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] reveals that the Numbers came from [[Punk Hazard]] and they are failures from experiments trying to recreate the [[Giants#Ancient Giant Tribe|ancient giant]] race.
**[[Jaki|One]] of them managed to catch the [[Brachio Tank V]], with [[Usopp]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] inside, but [[Franky]] frees them from the Number's grasp.
*[[Jinbe]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] help drive Big Mom off the stage.
*[[Queen]] prevents [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] from going to the roof of the Skull Dome.
*[[King]] creates an air blockade alongside several flying Gifters to make sure the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] cannot go after [[Kaidou]].
*Usopp and Chopper exit the Brachio Tank V so Franky can form [[Battle Frankies/General Franky|General Franky]].
*[[Sanji]] is shown to have withstood his clash with King.
*All of the Straw Hats gather at the [[Skull Dome#Live Floor|Live Floor]].
